project_context.direction: RTL or LTR based on project setup
project_context.data_source: Use existing project state/context for 'Latest Bookings' (اخر الحجوزات) instead of static dummy data.

styling_rules.border_radius: Rounded-xl (12px) for cards, Rounded-lg (8px) for inputs/buttons
styling_rules.shadows: Soft drop shadow for the right-side summary card (shadow-lg or shadow-md)
styling_rules.spacing: Generous padding inside cards (p-6), standard gaps between elements (gap-4)

layout_structure.desktop: Two-column CSS Grid or Flexbox. Left: 60% (Payment Options), Right: 40% (Booking Summary).
layout_structure.mobile: Single column, flex-col. Booking Summary should stack below or above Payment Options naturally.

elements: Cancel Booking Button (Text link, distinct color like red/pink)
